title: Detailed top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Crown of the hat -->
  <rect x="28" y="20" width="44" height="48" rx="4" fill="#3A3A5C"/>
  <!-- Lighter left side for dimension -->
  <rect x="28" y="20" width="10" height="48" rx="4" fill="#525280"/>
  <!-- Subtle highlight -->
  <rect x="30" y="22" width="6" height="44" rx="3" fill="#6B6BA0"/>
  
  <!-- Curved top of crown -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="20" rx="22" ry="5" fill="#4A4A70"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="20" rx="16" ry="3.5" fill="#5E5E8E"/>
  <!-- Top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="19" rx="8" ry="2" fill="#7A7AB5"/>

  <!-- Hat band -->
  <rect x="28" y="54" width="44" height="10" rx="1" fill="#C0392B"/>
  <rect x="28" y="54" width="10" height="10" fill="#E74C3C"/>
  <rect x="30" y="55" width="6" height="8" fill="#FF6B5B"/>
  <!-- Band buckle -->
  <rect x="46" y="53" width="8" height="12" rx="1" fill="#D4A017"/>
  <rect x="47" y="54" width="6" height="10" rx="0.5" fill="#F0C040"/>
  <rect x="49" y="56" width="2" height="6" fill="#8B6914"/>

  <!-- Brim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="38" ry="9" fill="#3A3A5C"/>
  <!-- Brim top surface -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="38" ry="8" fill="#4A4A70"/>
  <!-- Brim highlight arc -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="64.5" rx="30" ry="6" fill="#5E5E8E"/>
  <!-- Brim front edge highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="38" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#6B6BA0" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Brim curl up on sides -->
  <path d="M12,65 Q14,57 20,60" stroke="#525280" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M88,65 Q86,57 80,60" stroke="#525280" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Crown vertical seam lines for detail -->
  <line x1="50" y1="22" x2="50" y2="54" stroke="#4A4A70" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="21" x2="40" y2="54" stroke="#4A4A70" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="21" x2="60" y2="54" stroke="#4A4A70" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Bottom shadow of brim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="36" ry="5" fill="#2E2E4A" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Shine on crown right side -->
  <rect x="62" y="24" width="4" height="26" rx="2" fill="#6B6BA0" opacity="0.4"/>
</svg>
